colinearity.verdict: the genomic order of the nine HOXD genes is monotonic with the anterior-posterior body axis -- linear order on the DNA equals order along the body. The sign is a convention (3'->5' vs anterior->posterior); the colinearity is the magnitude. This is the body-plan grammar G5.
